summary.short: Ordinance 2021-1518 completes France's transposition of EU Directive 2019/790 by amending the Intellectual Property Code. It adds copyright exceptions for text and data mining, teaching illustration and unavailable works, extends collective licensing, and extends the regime to neighbouring and database rights. Published 25 November 2021 (JORF).
summary.long: The ordinance completes France's transposition of EU Directive 2019/790 by amending the Intellectual Property Code. It adds three exceptions: text and data mining (L. 122-5-3; copies of lawfully accessed works for scientific research by research bodies and heritage institutions, and for any purpose unless rightsholders have opted out appropriately; copies stored securely and destroyed after mining), teaching and vocational illustration (L. 122-5-4; flat-rate remuneration; excluded where adequate licences are offered), and unavailable works held by heritage institutions (L. 122-5-5; author opposition; notice to the EU Intellectual Property Office at least six months before publication). It creates extended collective licensing, under which ministerially approved collective management organisations may extend licences to non-members (L. 324-8-1 to L. 324-8-6, L. 137-2-1, L. 139-1, L. 134-3 to L. 134-7). It also adds a chapter on unavailable works (L. 138-1 to L. 138-5) with ministerial approval of organisations, opposition rights, and exclusions for sets of works principally first published outside the EU. Neighbouring rights (L. 211-3, L. 211-8) and database producers' rights (L. 342-3, L. 342-6) are brought into parts of the regime. Articles 10 and 13 set which exceptions the first paragraph of L. 331-8 and L. 331-28/L. 331-31 do not apply to, and which amended provisions apply under L. 811-1-1. Several chapters defer implementing conditions to Conseil d'État decrees. The text sets no fines or penalties of its own. Publication date is taken from the document header (JORF of 25 November 2021).

notes: Text as published in the JORF of 25 Nov 2021; not a consolidated version. Visa citations of the laws of 2020-1508, 2020-1674 and 2021-1382 are recorded as legal_basis, but the text does not say which one is the delegating provision. The title's reference to amending directives 96/9/CE and 2001/29/CE describes the EU directive 2019/790, not changes made by this ordinance. Article 2 renumbers L. 122-6-1 V as VIII and inserts new V to VII. Article 10 2° quotes pre-2021 wording, applicable until 31 December 2021, with garbled text in the source (e.g., '2009,7° et 8°'). Article 13 I and II switch the reference from L. 331-31 to L. 331-28 from 1 January 2022, and Article 13 III provides an alternative version tied to ordinance 2019-1169. Article 7 1° contains the typo 'troisième at quatrième'.
